fieldData.description: Blazing the way for easy swaps at global scale. Ociswap is the first pairwise decentralized exchange in the special meow-y way that will be launched at the Radix Babylon release. Building exclusively on the future-proof Radix network with drastically reduced risk for hacks and exploits allows us to provide super easy, always fast and safe swaps at near zero cost.
